PROTOTYPE SHOWCASE

Grounding Ugandan Coffee Heritage in Global Export Excellence

Demo Coffee Exporters Ltd. serves as a demonstration portal showcasing how Ugandan origin coffees are processed, quality-verified, and exported to international markets.

OUR PURPOSE

Connecting Highland Smallholders Directly to Global Coffee Desks

Designed as a high-standard commodity export model, Demo Coffee Exporters Ltd. represents an integrated originator, dry miller, and green coffee logistics manager.

While Uganda has historically been recognized as Africa leading exporter of Robusta, this showcase illustrates how dedicated specialty divisions establish washing stations in Mount Elgon and the Rwenzori foothills to deliver high-scoring Arabica lots alongside fine Robusta.

Our Operational Pillars

01

Milling Integrity

We maintain strict separation between Arabica and Robusta processing streams at our Kampala mill, preventing flavor cross-contamination.

02

Fair Smallholder Remuneration

Farmer partners receive immediate cash settlements at farm-gate collection centers, plus quality bonus premiums upon cupping verification.

03

Supply Chain Predictability

From Kampala rail head to the Port of Mombasa, bonded logistics partners adhere to strict delivery timetables and container seal protocols.

CENTRAL FACILITY

Plot 45, Industrial Area, Kampala

Situated at the heart of Kampala export corridor, our industrial complex model integrates high-capacity dry milling, pneumatic grading, optical sorting, and climate-controlled parchment storage.

Section A

Secondary Hulling & Destoning

High-efficiency pre-cleaners, magnetic separators, and impact hullers gently remove dry husk and parchment without fracturing green seed embryos.

Section B

Screen Sizing & Optical Sorting

Vibratory screen decks sort beans according to standard screen gauges (Screen 18, 17, 15, and PB), followed by optical color sorters that inspect thousands of beans per second.

Section C

Bonded Stuffing Bays

Weather-sealed loading bays permit 20ft maritime containers to be backed directly into the mill, protecting bagged green coffee from tropical humidity during loading.

REGULATORY ACCREDITATION

Simulated National and Global Compliance

UCDA Alignment

Simulating export licensing and inspection procedures under the Uganda Coffee Development Authority.

EUDR Geolocation

Complete farm polygon data sets formatted for European Union Deforestation Regulation submission.

Q-Grader Protocols

In-house sensory lab model operated according to Specialty Coffee Association standards.

Phytosanitary Process

Official inspection certificates coordinated under Ministry of Agriculture guidelines.
